behaviors.given: a YouTube citation (source_type 'youtube' or unset) with video_title 'Test Video Title', video_url 'not-a-url', start_seconds 10, end_seconds 20, and a non-empty snippet 'Relevant text'
behaviors.then: the returned string contains the blockquote > "Relevant text" on its own line (preceded by a newline, as a continuation line)
behaviors.when: formatCitation is called with that citation

behaviors.given: the same citation as AC-1 (video_url 'not-a-url', snippet 'Relevant text', 10–20s range)
behaviors.then: the returned string starts with '- ' and still contains '(timestamp link unavailable)' and '0:10–0:20'
behaviors.when: formatCitation is called with that citation

behaviors.given: a citation with source_type 'dynamous', an empty (or whitespace-only) lesson_url, video_title 'Test Video Title', start_seconds 10, end_seconds 20, and a non-empty snippet (e.g. 'Test snippet text')
behaviors.then: the returned string starts with '- ', contains no '](', and still contains its snippet blockquote > "<snippet>" on its own line (e.g. > "Test snippet text" for snippet 'Test snippet text')
behaviors.when: formatCitation is called with that citation

behaviors.given: a YouTube citation whose video_url parses but has no v parameter (e.g. 'https://www.youtube.com/'), with a non-empty snippet 'Relevant text'
behaviors.then: the returned string starts with '- ', still contains '(timestamp link unavailable)', and contains the blockquote > "Relevant text" on its own line
behaviors.when: formatCitation is called with that citation

invariants: Only app/frontend/src/lib/exportMarkdown.ts may change among production files; test changes are confined to app/frontend/src/lib/exportMarkdown.test.ts.

Every existing test case in exportMarkdown.test.ts keeps passing, including the console.warn assertions: both YouTube fallback triggers (unparseable video_url and missing v parameter) must still warn with the byte-identical payload '[exportMarkdown] Skipping timestamp link — invalid video_url: "<video_url>"' (em dash U+2014 inside the message).
Preserve the exact Unicode separators the existing tests assert: em dash '—' (U+2014) between the title/link and the timestamp range, en dash '–' (U+2013) inside ranges such as '0:10–0:20'.
The empty-snippet guard is unchanged in behavior: formatCitation still returns '' when snippet is absent, empty, or whitespace-only.
The two valid paths (YouTube URL with a v param; Dynamous with a lesson_url) keep their current output shape '- [Title](url) — <range>' followed by the continuation line '  > "<snippet>"'.

Fallback entries emit the snippet blockquote in the same continuation-line shape the valid paths use (newline, then the indented '> "<snippet>"' line), so every entry of a formatSources list is a '- '-prefixed markdown list item and none merges into the previous list item when rendered.
No new or version-changed dependencies; formatTimestamp, the export header, and the filename slug are untouched.

The new acceptance tests must be red on the unchanged tree (the current suite passes because the invalid-URL and no-v-param cases assert only substrings the buggy fallback output already contains); each new case must assert what the buggy return lacks — the snippet blockquote and/or the leading '- ' marker.

issue.title: fix(export): markdown export drops the transcript snippet when a citation URL cannot be parsed

out_of_scope: Backend, schema/database, and any dependency changes.
app/frontend/src/components/CitationModal.tsx, Message.tsx, ChatArea.tsx, Sidebar.tsx, and any other component or hook changes.
The valid-URL and valid-lesson_url return paths of formatCitation (their current output shape is pinned by existing tests).
formatTimestamp behavior, the export header, and the filename slug.
Changing or removing the console.warn fallback warnings or their payload text.
risks: Only exportMarkdown.test.ts is known to assert these strings, but a repo-wide check that no other test (e.g. a component snapshot) depends on the marker-less fallback strings is owned by the kernel's unit gate.
The two YouTube fallback branches carry duplicated console.warn blocks; any dedup during the fix must keep the message byte-identical (em dash U+2014) or existing tests fail.

formatSources joins entries with '\n' only, so a fallback entry still missing '- ' would merge into the previous list item when rendered — the marker is the fix for that user-visible symptom and must not be applied at the caller instead.
Biome format/lint and tsc must pass on the edited files; template-literal indentation inside the returned strings is significant output, not style.
summary: Fix the three fallback return paths of formatCitation in app/frontend/src/lib/exportMarkdown.ts — unparseable video_url, video_url without a v parameter, and Dynamous with empty lesson_url — so every emitted citation entry starts with the '- ' markdown list marker and carries the quoted transcript snippet blockquote on its own line, matching the shape the two valid paths already emit; add red-first acceptance tests to the existing exportMarkdown.test.ts.
